graham.brief:
What changed for Cincinnati between the open and this morning? The total has climbed from 51 to 52 during the week. Cincinnati is favored by 2.5, which works out to about 27 points from them. It's a real shift for Cincinnati.

Cincinnati is the 2nd-most pass-first offense in football, throwing more than the situation calls for. Jacksonville finishes drives, 2nd-best in the league at turning trips near the goal line into touchdowns. Trevor Lawrence's pass attempts held at 29.

Cincinnati has struggled when the defense sends extra rushers, and Jacksonville sends extra rushers more than most. Joe Burrow is the starter who's played 100% of the snaps. Burrow's line is 36.5 pass attempts, above the 34.3 he's averaging. They've set Chase Brown at 16.5 rush attempts, above the 16.3 he's averaging.

Count Cincinnati's throws over the first two series, because steady throws mean this matchup decides it and fewer mean another plan.
